tasks.title: Lock feat plan, tool inventory, and requirements baseline
tasks.summary: Create the K-006 feat, record the dual-readable/pipeline-aware requirements, enumerate every in-scope tool, and commit the baseline planning docs before implementation starts.

tasks.title: Add builtin contract metadata and man/manual plumbing
tasks.summary: Introduce explicit builtin ACI contract fields, use them in man summary/list rendering, and establish the manual contract sections that later tool tasks will fill in.

tasks.title: Optimize tree
tasks.summary: Redesign tree toward a higher-signal dual-readable default and add an explicit structured mode without pretending it is a strong pipeline primitive.

tasks.title: Optimize grep
tasks.summary: Keep grep pipe-friendly by default while adding an explicit structured record mode and clearer contract/docs.

tasks.title: Optimize find
tasks.summary: Preserve path-per-line default behavior for composition while adding an explicit structured result mode and clearer command contract.

tasks.title: Optimize wc
tasks.summary: Replace weak positional default output with a more readable compact form and add an explicit structured mode.

tasks.title: Optimize env
tasks.summary: Improve env readability for list-like values such as PATH and add an explicit structured mode without hurting terminal use.

tasks.title: Optimize type
tasks.summary: Replace sentence-heavy output with a more regular dual-readable form and add an explicit structured mode.

tasks.title: Optimize which
tasks.summary: Keep simple path output for shell use while adding an explicit structured mode and clearer lookup contract.

tasks.title: Optimize mkdir
tasks.summary: Preserve low-noise mutation behavior while adding an explicit confirmation mode and documenting its contract.

tasks.title: Optimize touch
tasks.summary: Preserve shell composability while adding an explicit confirmation/structured mode for created or validated paths.

tasks.title: Optimize cp
tasks.summary: Keep default copy behavior quiet enough for shell workflows while adding explicit confirmation/structured output and clearer docs.

tasks.title: Optimize mv
tasks.summary: Keep move/rename behavior shell-friendly while adding explicit confirmation/structured output and clearer contract docs.

tasks.title: Optimize rm
tasks.summary: Keep delete behavior low-noise by default while adding an explicit confirmation mode and better agent-facing docs.

tasks.title: Optimize rmdir
tasks.summary: Preserve empty-directory semantics while adding an explicit confirmation mode and clearer dual-readable docs.

tasks.title: Optimize tee
tasks.summary: Keep tee as a strong pipeline primitive while adding optional structured/confirmation output and explicit stdin contract docs.

tasks.title: Optimize sed
tasks.summary: Keep sed print-mode composition intact while adding optional structured mutation summaries for in-place edit flows.

tasks.title: Add JSON query tooling
tasks.summary: Introduce the first stronger structure-aware query builtin for JSON so agents can extract targeted data from structured files without whole-file dumps.

tasks.title: Refresh README and aggregate docs after tool rollout
tasks.summary: Summarize the builtin ACI wave, update README and design docs, and close the feat after all tool-level commits are merged.

tasks.title: Reframe README and architecture around kernel and default workspace
tasks.summary: Reorganize README and docs/architecture.md so they explain simsh in agent-facing dependency order: kernel, default workspace/ACI, adapters, then entry surfaces.
